candidates.after_diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[Profiling module] --> S[Committed Repository snapshot interface]
  S --> F[Framework detector implementation]
  F --> C[Code Unit framework facts]
candidates.before_diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[Profiling module] -->|archive RootPath| F[Framework detector adapter]
  F -->|git rev-parse| G[Missing Git metadata]
  G --> X[DetectorFailed]
must_relationships: Story 4.2 AC-3 requires deterministic framework facts for each applicable Code Unit, but the pinned production seam supplies a snapshot representation the framework detector implementation cannot read.
Story 4.3 AC-1 requires the post-profile pass to inspect supported framework facts, but the framework detector fails before that pass can complete.
candidates.problem: The profiling module passes an archive-only committed Repository snapshot RootPath to the framework detector adapter, whose implementation immediately requires Git metadata, so production framework profiling fails closed before Code Unit framework facts can be produced.
candidates.solution: Deepen the committed Repository snapshot module so the framework detector implementation consumes the same revision-bound snapshot semantics as the other profiling modules.
candidates.title: Unify committed Repository snapshot semantics for framework detection

candidates.after_diagram:
flowchart LR
  C[Profiling construction] --> R[Required detector seam]
  R --> A[Evidence-derived Pre-Scan Result]
candidates.before_diagram:
flowchart LR
  C[Profiling construction] --> R[Real detector adapter]
  C --> E[Empty detector adapter]
  E --> A[pre_scan_approved]
must_relationships: Story 4.3 AC-1 requires deterministic RPC and HTTP Communication Kind Classification after Repository profiling; the compatibility adapter performs no detection.
Story 4.3 AC-3 permits an approved result after the deterministic pass completes, while this adapter manufactures pre_scan_approved from only the Profiled Revision.
candidates.problem: The profiling module exposes public construction paths that install an EmptyPreScanCommunicationDetector adapter, and its implementation always creates pre_scan_approved without examining Code Units or evidence, so callers and much of the integration test surface can bypass required Communication Kind Classification.
candidates.solution: Remove the bypass construction paths so every profiling module instance requires the real Pre-Scan detection seam and tests cross the same interface.
candidates.title: Remove the empty Pre-Scan approval construction path

candidates.after_diagram:
flowchart LR
  R[Scan Run repository interface] --> A[Atomic profile-to-approval implementation]
candidates.before_diagram:
flowchart LR
  R[Scan Run repository interface] --> P[Profile-only commit]
  R --> A[Profile plus approval commit]
must_relationships: Story 4.3 AC-3 requires profiling facts and the Pre-Scan Result to commit atomically for one ScanRun.
Story 4.3 AC-6 requires persistence failure to leave no partially approved Pre-Scan Result, while the older interface can commit a completed profile without any result.
candidates.problem: The Scan Run repository interface still exposes a profile-only persistence path whose implementation commits Code Units and profiling facts without a Pre-Scan Result, leaving a public seam that bypasses the required atomic profile-to-approval invariant.
candidates.solution: Retire the profile-only path so the repository module has one atomic profile-to-approval implementation and one persistence test surface.
candidates.title: Retire the profile-only persistence path

candidates.after_diagram:
flowchart LR
  T[Tests] --> F[Framework detector interface]
  E[E2E] --> P[Full profiling interface]
  F --> I[Detector implementation]
candidates.before_diagram:
flowchart LR
  T[Tests] -->|reflection strings| I[Detector implementation]
  E[E2E] -->|manual composition| C[Communication detector]
must_relationships: This supports Story 4.2 AC-3 and Story 4.3 integration coverage, but the test-shape debt is not itself a violated runtime MUST.
candidates.problem: Framework detection tests discover concrete methods and result properties by strings and reflection while the Story 4.3 E2E test manually skips the profiling and framework adapter composition, so the interface is not the test surface and the production seam mismatch escaped.
candidates.solution: Make the framework detector interface and the full committed Repository profiling path the test surfaces while keeping parsing seams inside the implementation.
candidates.title: Make the framework detector interface the test surface

candidates.after_diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[Profiling coordinator] --> F[Deep framework detector module]
  P --> C[Deep communication detector module]
  F --> FC[Catalog implementation]
  C --> CC[Catalog implementation]
candidates.before_diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[Profiling coordinator] --> F[Framework detector]
  P --> FC[Framework catalog]
  P --> C[Communication detector]
  P --> CC[Communication catalog]
must_relationships: Story 4.2 requires a closed framework catalog and Story 4.3 requires deterministic rule provenance; both remain satisfied, but their implementation knowledge currently leaks across the orchestration seam.
candidates.problem: The profiling coordinator depends on both detector interfaces and their concrete catalogs, then repeats package-coordinate interpretation and rule-set provenance even though the detector implementations already own those catalogs, reducing locality and widening the module interface.
candidates.solution: Concentrate catalog interpretation and provenance inside the detector modules, leaving orchestration to compose already-normalized domain facts.
candidates.title: Keep catalog knowledge inside detector modules
